schema: ares-hirise-display-layer 0.1 (proposed in CR-003; not part of contract v1.0.0)
layer_role: DISPLAY ONLY. Not a routing input. Routes, lengths, profiles and model costs stay on the CTX 20 m grid.
crs_note: Same projection as the CTX bundle: equirectangular, lat_ts 18.4663, sphere R 3396190 m; planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude; row 0 = north edge; x0/y0 = upper-left pixel corner.

dtm_2m.encoding: float32 little-endian, row-major, north row first, NaN = invalid

dtm_4m.encoding: float32 little-endian, row-major, north row first, NaN = invalid

ortho_0p5m.encoding: 8-bit grayscale JPEG q90, source DN averaged, no stretch. Invalid cells are counted in n_invalid (stored as DN 0 before JPEG); lossy JPEG can also decode very dark valid pixels to DN 0, so use n_invalid, not DN 0, as the NoData record

ortho_1m.encoding: 8-bit grayscale JPEG q90, 2x2 block mean of the 0.5 m texture before JPEG; same NoData rule as ortho_0p5m

elevation.vertical_reference: UNVERIFIED: source file names say MOLAtopography_DeltaGeoid; heights were tied to the USGS CTX LVS DTM via ground control; the metadata names no datum

ctx_minus_hirise_at_20m_m.method: dtm_2m 10x10 block mean vs CTX bundle dem.f32.bin on the identical 20 m grid

line_artifacts_1m_source.description: coherent east-west row steps over >= 100 m segments in the 1 m source DTM; processing/mosaic artifacts, not geology; left unedited and disclosed

elevation.effective_resolution_note: 1 m post spacing; effective topographic resolution of stereo DTMs is coarser (often quoted ~3x post spacing). Not verified here.

registration.method: high-pass (15 px box) NCC shift search, HiRISE 0.5 m texture block-averaged to the 5 m CTX bundle ortho grid, sub-pixel parabola
registration.reference: CTX bundle ortho.jpg (fc22a0c8a91f), itself not quantitatively registered to the CTX DEM (G1/S-4 open)
registration.uncertainty_basis: half a 5 m CTX ortho pixel for the sub-pixel peak; USGS: 94.1% of HiRISE-vs-CTX LVS features within 6 m
registration.why_not_applied: offset is below one 20 m CTX analysis cell and within published uncertainty; the CTX reference is itself not validated (S-4), so HiRISE is not forced onto it

McEwen, A. S. et al. (2007). Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter's High Resolution Imaging Science Experiment (HiRISE). J. Geophys. Res. 112, E05S04. https://doi.org/10.1029/2005JE002605
credit: HiRISE images: NASA/JPL-Caltech/University of Arizona. DTM and orthomosaic: USGS Astrogeology. Historical orbital data (2006-2017 acquisitions), before the 2021 landing: no lander, rover or tracks are visible.
processing: 1. Read the actual source pixels over ROI-A plus a 40 m margin via HTTP range requests (windows recorded above).
2. DTM: ISIS NULL (< -1e30) -> invalid. Warp from eqc lat_ts=0 to the CTX eqc lat_ts=18.4663 grid at 2 m with GDAL average resampling (area-weighted mean; ~4.2 source pixels per cell, no upsampling).
3. Coverage mask warped the same way; a cell with any NoData contribution is set invalid (NaN). No filling or interpolation through NoData.

5. Ortho SOC_007: warp from orthographic (lat_0 18.4663, lon_0 77.4298) to the same grid at 0.5 m with GDAL average (4 source pixels per cell); DN rounded, no contrast stretch; 0 kept as NoData. ortho_1m = 2x2 block mean before JPEG.
6. No vertical shift and no horizontal correction applied; offsets vs CTX measured and recorded only.
limitations: Display only: not used for routing, route length, elevation profile or model cost.
Vertical datum UNVERIFIED; heights differ from the CTX bundle (see ctx_minus_hirise_at_20m_m).
No per-pixel DTM confidence layer is published; only aggregate accuracies in the USGS metadata.
21 east-west line artifacts (see line_artifacts_1m_source) are visible in shaded relief and at vertical exaggeration.
A route drawn on this surface is a visualization; it is not validated for human walking.
G1/S-4, S2 (POI coordinates), S6 (cost curve) and the vertical datum remain open.
